capabilities: Open web AI assistants in an embedded tab view
Switch between assistants via a top tab bar
Add, edit, delete, and reorder custom AI entries with names, icons, and URLs
Open non-embeddable assistants in a popup window
Refresh one or all assistants and toggle the tab bar or default AI in settings
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant for your notes; it only embeds the web versions of AI chat sites in tabs, it does not send note content to a model.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (Chinese/English). Author accepts donations via Aifadian (爱发电). Whether an assistant embeds or needs a popup depends on the target site's frame restrictions.
problem: Using multiple AI chat assistants means leaving Obsidian and opening separate sites or apps; there is no single place to switch between them inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Built-in support for 20+ mainstream AI assistants (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Doubao, Ernie, Gemini, and more)
